Error in parse(text = x) : <text>:2:0: unexpected end of input
1: 93681305715 * RUR_100Z) + offset(0.957952453936899 * FOR1_100Z) +
offset(0.583459722341052 * CR_CL_2Z) + offset(0.0689024454866721 *
Is_sizeZ) + offset(0.312482737825823 * rd_up_100Z) + offset
